tracking: ADR-0238 (P12(d)): the brief is API-only; the token-exchange form and scope map are posted on #453. Master decision 2026-11-08 (#712 unblock): keep as a known gap until that screen is built

gaps.GET /v1/servers/:serverId/token-exchange: reads an MCP server's upstream token-exchange configuration and per-action scope map (never the secret)
gaps.PUT /v1/servers/:serverId/token-exchange: sets or changes an MCP server's upstream token exchange (settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/servers/:serverId/token-excha: removes an MCP server's upstream token exchange (settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.GET /v1/connectors/:connectorId/token-ex: reads a connector's upstream token-exchange configuration and per-action scope map (never the secret)
gaps.PUT /v1/connectors/:connectorId/token-ex: sets or changes a connector's upstream token exchange (settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/connectors/:connectorId/token: removes a connector's upstream token exchange (settings_relax step-up, audited)
